integrity: A complete exact finite orbit-chain verifier with reproducible output is embedded. Independent validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Determines three-local and rational reduced homology of the ordinary affine quotient only; no conclusion on 2- or 17-primary torsion, fundamental group, homotopy type, or Borel equivariant cohomology. Nonequivariant Paley-17 Moore-space decomposition is prior work. Possible unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk.
title: Three-torsion survives the affine quotient of the Paley-17 neighborhood complex
